notes: Subsidiary of Rolls-Royce Holdings plc; only distinct financing of Rolls-Royce SMR Ltd is recorded (parent-company finance is excluded). Correction to the brief: contemporary 2021 sources (WNN, BBC) name Rolls-Royce Group, BNF Resources UK and Exelon Generation as the GBP195M investors; Qatar Investment Authority is listed as a shareholder only on the company investors page (and later press), with no date or amount, so QIA is not entered as a participant of the 2021 round. The UKRI grant (GBP210M, announced 2021-11-09) is public funding matched with the GBP195M equity; do not add them together as one round. GBE-N: contract formally signed 2026-04-13 after the June 2025 preferred-partner selection; the contract value is not announced (GBP2.6bn is GBE-N's Spending Review allocation, not an award to Rolls-Royce SMR), so the agreement carries no value. The National Wealth Fund loan (up to GBP599M, market rate, for generic design work) was announced on the same day; reported by New Civil Engineer quoting the government statement (no direct gov.uk page was archived for it). CEZ took a 20% stake in October 2024 for "several hundred million pounds" per the Czech PM office (no exact amount; not entered). Canada G&C, TED (no RR SMR notice), BODACC (UK company) and CORDIS (UK, not funded) probes have no records. Verifier: the NWF loan is a facility "made available" ("the loan would be issued"), with no drawdown reported, so it is a ceiling (programme maximum), not money received. The GBP195M equity is committed "over about three years" (phased), kept as the announced commitment.
